episodes.title: The Good Father
episodes.summary: Following Martin's death, Frasier returns to Boston for a college lecture and to check in on his son, Freddy—whom he quickly suspects is keeping a secret from him.

episodes.title: Moving In
episodes.summary: Frasier hopes to make up for lost time with Freddy, but a disagreement over where to put a small Red Sox souvenir quickly escalates into a battle of wills between father and son.

episodes.title: First Class
episodes.summary: Frasier begins a new career at the university, determined to be taken seriously as an academic—but finds that a nearly twenty year stint as a daytime talk show host is not easy to escape.

episodes.title: Trivial Pursuits
episodes.summary: Freddy aims to show his father that he's not "just a firefighter," but rather part of a noble and fulfilling cause - then picks the worst possible day to invite Frasier to the firehouse.

episodes.title: The Founders' Society
episodes.summary: Frasier joins Alan and Olivia as they seek membership in the university's prestigious "Founders' Society." Meanwhile, David digs into Freddy's personal life for a surprising reason.

episodes.title: Blind Date
episodes.summary: Eve agrees to set both Frasier and Freddy up on blind dates, but when both women are expected on the same evening, father and son start to turn on each other...

episodes.title: Freddy's Birthday
episodes.summary: Frasier discovers that Freddy has been seeing Lilith behind his back, which sets up a battle between the two exes for their grown son's affection...

episodes.title: The B Story
episodes.summary: Frasier attempts to convince the university's provost to grant him full professor status. David faces a life-shattering crisis that takes all of Freddy's help to get him through...

episodes.title: The Fix Is In
episodes.summary: When Freddy complains about being treated like a child, Frasier suggests that he help with repairs around the apartment, but things get more complicated.

episodes.title: Reindeer Games
episodes.summary: On Christmas Eve, Freddy stretches himself to be there for Frasier, who's coping with Martin's death by throwing a lavish party, and Eve, who's hiding out at home dealing with her own loss.

episodes.title: Ham
episodes.summary: Frasier falls out with Alan when he finds out that Alan talked Freddy into quitting Harvard; Eve and David are asked by Frasier to watch after an imported beef.

episodes.title: Cyrano, Cyrano
episodes.summary: Determined to "give Cupid a win" on Valentine's Day, Frasier inadvertently becomes involved with both sides of a troubled relationship.

episodes.title: All About Eve
episodes.summary: Roz takes Eve and Olivia out for a girls' night, leaving Frasier, Alan and Freddy to take care of Eve's baby.

episodes.title: The Dedication
episodes.summary: When Frasier discovers that Freddy has been seeing a therapist, he tracks her down in an attempt to find out what the matter is.

episodes.title: The Squash Courtship of Freddy's Father
episodes.summary: Frasier's agent Bebe Glazer visits, leading Frasier to wonder how he can have more in common with her daughter than with his own son.

episodes.title: Cape Cod
episodes.summary: When Frasier sees that Eve is ready to date again, he enlists Roz's help to plan a romantic weekend for her and Freddy at a Cape Cod beach house.

episodes.title: My Brilliant Sister
episodes.summary: Frasier tracks down a reclusive author at his tailgate party. Meanwhile, Olivia deals with two fake boyfriends in an attempt to impress her sister.

episodes.title: Thank You, Dr. Crane
episodes.summary: When Frasier returns to Seattle for a KACL anniversary special, he reconnects with a former caller whose life went off the rails after he took Frasier's advice. While, Alan's lack of appreciation drives David to quit.

episodes.title: Murder Most Finch
episodes.summary: When Olivia hosts a surprise murder mystery party, Frasier tries everything he can to get himself and his date out of the evening's festivities.

episodes.title: Father Christmas
episodes.summary: As Christmas approaches, Frasier enlists the entire gang to help Alan reunite with his estranged daughter and meet his new grandchild.
